image_description: A close-up photograph of two white daisy-like flowers with yellow centers against a blurred natural background. The primary flower is in sharp focus on the right, showing distinct white ray petals and a textured yellow disc. A second, slightly out-of-focus flower is visible at the bottom center. Green stems support both flowers, rising from a soft-focus background of green foliage and earth tones.
